title: IBM Security Part 1
description:
Hello! Welcome to today’s episode of the Healthcare Security Brief podcast, where we will explore the evolving landscape of cybersecurity and the partnerships helping healthcare organizations stay resilient. Today, we’re excited to welcome Salwa Rafee, managing partner, author, and cybersecurity practice lead at IBM Security, along with Dr. Bonnie Netschert, program lead for cybersecurity and the Global Security partnership with Microsoft at IBM Security. In part one of this discussion, we dive into the shifting healthcare threat landscape, why cybersecurity has become directly tied to patient safety, the rise of ransomware and AI-driven attacks, and how healthcare organizations can modernize security strategies through zero trust, medical device protection, and compliance automation.

title: Series Introduction
description:
We're excited to introduce a new podcast series called the Microsoft Healthcare Security Brief. The objective of this new podcast series is to bring together some of our strategic partners in the healthcare security space for a personal discussion on topics we feel can help healthcare organizations be more resilient and proactive across the evolving threat landscape, and hear firsthand some of the experiences and recommendations our partners can share.
